description: This file contains the implementation of an Orleans hosted service and a grain used for activation shedding testing. It manages grain activation load, monitors memory usage, and collects statistics on grain memory consumption.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyHostedService
classes.description: A background service that manages grain activation load, monitors memory usage, and collects statistics for activation shedding testing.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: A grain implementation that simulates activity by holding a buffer and responding to ping requests.

classes.name: IActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: Interface defining the grain's contract with a Ping method.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main loop of the hosted service that manages grain activation, monitors memory, and collects stats.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Prints current memory and activation statistics.

methods.name: PlotAndPrintStats
methods.description: Calculates and displays marginal memory usage per grain between data points.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method to simulate activity in the grain.
